notes: Fiscal year ended December 31, 2024 (matches data.js fy 'Dec 2024'). Financial figures are from the FY2024 Form 10-K (accession 0001628280-25-003063) and match SEC XBRL. OWNERSHIP is from the 2025 proxy statement (DEF 14A filed September 17, 2025, accession 0001104659-25-090866), as of September 15, 2025. OPTIONS: the 19.8% includes 303,960,630 shares Musk can acquire by exercising options within 60 days; under SEC rules those option shares are added to both his holding and the denominator for his row only. The rest, 413,362,808 shares, is held by the Elon Musk Revocable Trust. For reference only (computed, not stated in the filing): 413,362,808 / 3,325,150,886 is about 12.4%. The proxy says the 717,323,438 figure excludes 96,000,000 restricted shares under the 2025 CEO Interim Award, which he may vote, and that 235,998,721 of his shares are pledged. EARLIER FIGURE: Tesla's 10-K/A of April 30, 2025 (accession 0001104659-25-042659, Part III) reported Musk at 714,754,706 shares, 20.3%, based on 3,216,138,890 shares outstanding at December 31, 2024; the later proxy figure is used per the brief. HOLDERS: the Vanguard and BlackRock rows rely on Schedule 13G filings from early 2024 (filed February 13, 2024 and January 29, 2024); the proxy gives only filing dates, not the dates the holdings refer to, so asOf is null, and the percentages are stale against the September 2025 share count. BUYBACKS: the 2024 cash-flow statement has no share repurchase line, so 0. STOCK COMP: 1,999 million is the cash-flow add-back; the equity statement shows 2,199 million including amounts capitalized.
